issues.title: Alternate Task Group Strategy
issues.body:
We have these issues related to Task Groups:
* currently preventing `un-select-all` working (though this should be fixable)
* have to generate outcomes for assets,  not the Task Group (dev chore)
* planning challenge in splitting/combining Task Groups (backend maintenance chore)

I've come up with this alternate strategy - to remove Task Groups as organisational unit - just have the assets in the table. 

This brings these benefits:
* un-select-all works
* we already generate outcomes for assets in area
* groups don't get split/merged

To allow players to manage task groups, we would add optional "Task Group" attribute for maritime platforms.  Task Group would be a chooseable column in the assets tab.  So, players can then choose to view TAsk Group column, and sort/filter by it.

For an asset to detach from the task group - the players simply give orders to that asset.  Game Admins can edit the `task group` attribute - but that's a much more straight-forward task than moving into out of parent task group - it could even be done via the admin pages.
